name: Riders of the Storm
review:
Storm riders on 243 ways, with mystery wild reels and wild multipliers. In the bonus you choose your volatility option, and walking wilds move across the reels.

Being able to pick your risk level inside the bonus is a nice touch. Very high volatility, a 26,426x cap and an RTP of 96.14–96.15%. One of Thunderkick's biggest ceilings.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
